jobs.description:
Are you passionate about test automation, cutting-edge technology, and building reliable solutions? Take on a key role in developing and improving quality assurance for advanced financial crime prevention platforms at one of the Nordic region’s largest banks. Join a collaborative team where your expertise in automation, data testing, and AI-driven testing approaches will make a real impact!
About the position
Perido are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer for our client, one of the largest banks in the Nordic region. The position is based at the bank’s office just north of Stockholm.
Your daily tasks
In this role, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime. The environment includes cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. You will work closely with developers, Business Analysts, Requirement Engineers, and architects to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a separate final step.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Python and/or Java and appropriate test automation frameworks
Apply AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis, and maintenance
Test data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality, and data transformations across GCP
Validate rule-based detection engines and complex business logic used in Financial Crime Prevention
Test APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows across distributed systems
Define and continuously improve test strategy, regression coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end testing
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
Ensure AI-generated test assets and results are appropriately reviewed, validated, traceable, and reproducible
Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them
Promote good testing practices and support the wider team in continuously improving quality engineering

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is analytical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a genuine interest in quality and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking initiative, solving complex problems and working independently, while also enjoying close collaboration with others. You have a structured approach to your work and the ability to communicate technical matters clearly to different stakeholders.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.
Qualifications:
8–10+ years of relevant experience in test automation, technical testing, quality engineering, or testing of complex software systems
Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation solutions and frameworks
Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, together with good SQL knowledge
Practical experience with AI-assisted or agentic testing, including the use of AI or agents within the software testing lifecycle
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, preferably including technologies such as BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Composer
Strong experience in data, ETL, and data quality testing
Experience testing rule-based systems, decision engines, or complex business logic
Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, CI/CD, and end-to-end testing
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships between data, technology, business requirements, and controls
A proactive, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively in a cross-functional agile team
Strong communication and documentation skills
A B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D., or equivalent relevant education and professional experience

 
Advantageous:
Experience within banking, Financial Crime Prevention, transaction monitoring, compliance, or another regulated environment
Experience applying AI-enabled development or testing tools in professional software engineering
ISTQB or similar testing certification
Google Cloud certification
Requirements Engineering certification, such as REQB or equivalent

Contract type and hours
Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-12-31. Start 2027-01-01.
Let us help you take the next step in your career
Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. As part of ASSA ABLOY, we are now expanding into the Swedish market.

As the face of Kentix in the Swedish market, you'll build relationships with end customers and partners, create new business opportunities and help establish Kentix as a recognized provider of physical IT security solutions.

Why Kentix

jobs.occupation: Software Product Developer to Mycronic Pattern Generator
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing.
In this role, you will be part of a larger team of 18 people responsible for the software and data processing that enable the machines to carry out their operations. The team works across a wide range of areas, from applications and data conversion to operating systems, computer hardware and internal networks. A key part of the work involves preparing and processing large volumes of data, with high demands on performance and reliability. This role will give you a broad understanding of how software and hardware interact within a complex system. You are not expected to know everything from day one. Curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to collaborate with colleagues with different areas of expertise are just as important.
Work tasks
In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine new product development with problem-solving and the continuous improvement of existing systems. Your primary focus will be software development in Java, where you will contribute to enhancing existing features, modernising systems, and addressing technical challenges within an advanced product environment. Your responsibilities will also include troubleshooting issues reported by customers, testing on physical test systems, and optimising code where performance is critical.
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Developing and enhancing product software, primarily in Java.
Implementing new features and contributing to the modernisation of existing solutions while ensuring compatibility with previous product versions.
Writing tests and verifying functionality on physical test systems across various computer and system configurations.
Handling customer support cases through analysis and troubleshooting.
Developing software for user interaction and generating executable programs for the system.
Collaborating with colleagues across different technical disciplines to understand problems, identify solutions, and ensure that changes work seamlessly across the entire system.
Contributing ideas and suggestions for improvement as part of an ongoing product development process, driven by customer feedback and technological advancements.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are curious and eager to understand how technology works as a whole. You take initiative, work independently and take ownership of your tasks, from initial analysis through to the delivery of a finished solution. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and collaborating with others to achieve the best possible results. You are also adaptable, able to adjust when circumstances change, and thrive in a fast-paced development environment.
Furthermore, you have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
At least a few years of experience in software development, working with products that combine both hardware and software.
Good knowledge of Java or experience with another object-oriented programming language, such as C++.
Experience in software development in a Linux environment.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience in user interface development, preferably using frameworks such as React or similar.
Knowledge of agile development methodologies.

Start: By agreement 
Scope: Full-time 
Location: Täby

jobs.occupation: Licensed Veterinarian to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
jobs.description:
We are looking for a licensed veterinarian with a few years of professional experience who wants to become part of our team and work broadly within small animal practice. With us, you will have the opportunity to use and further develop your expertise across several areas, from outpatient care and inpatient wards to emergency medicine, surgery, and on-call work.
About AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital provides highly qualified medical, emergency, and surgical veterinary care in a dynamic emergency setting and a welcoming environment.
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital is part of Area North, which includes animal hospitals and clinics across fourteen locations. The hospital consists of the Emergency Department, Inpatient Care Ward, Surgery Department, Outpatient Clinic, Rehabilitation Department, as well as support functions including Telephone Services and Reception.
My name is Jens Berisson, and I work as the Hospital Director here at AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital. We are now looking to strengthen our fantastic team and are seeking a licensed veterinarian who is passionate about animal healthcare and wants to continue developing the hospital together with us.
About the Role
This role is ideal for someone who appreciates that no two days are the same. Your primary focus will be tailored to your experience and interests, but we would like you to be comfortable working across different areas of the hospital.
Examples of responsibilities include:

Outpatient consultations and medical workups.

Care of hospitalized patients in the inpatient ward.

Emergency patients and emergency medicine.

Surgery and perioperative care.

On-call and evening shifts.

More advanced cases based on your competence and experience.

Who Are You?
We believe you are a veterinarian who:

Is a licensed veterinarian with several years of clinical experience.

Is confident in your professional role and able to work independently.

Has experience from multiple areas of small animal practice, such as outpatient care, inpatient care, emergency medicine, and/or surgery.

Enjoys a varied caseload and is motivated to broaden your clinical expertise.

Is confident in making clinical decisions and prioritizing when required.

Has a genuine interest in high-quality patient care and professional communication with pet owners.

Is a team player who enjoys collaborating with skilled and dedicated colleagues.

Is curious and wants to continue developing professionally, whether by deepening expertise in a specific area or maintaining a broad clinical role.

Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Experience in emergency medicine, surgery, or a specialist qualification in canine and feline medicine is considered an advantage.
Why Choose AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital?
At AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital, you will become part of a dedicated and highly competent team where collaboration, job satisfaction, and patient focus are at the heart of everything we do.
We are a well-equipped animal hospital with extensive expertise in areas such as surgery, anaesthesia, emergency care, and advanced diagnostics. This provides excellent opportunities for both variety and continued professional development.
What many of our employees appreciate most is the strong sense of community. Here, we support one another, share knowledge, and work together to provide the best possible care for our patients.
About AniCura Sweden
Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that offers outstanding opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation, and professional development.
With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with operations spanning the entire country and a strong local presence.
Our dedicated teams work together every day to provide the highest standard of care for every patient. Through a culture characterized by collaboration, continuous learning, and medical excellence, you will have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and truly make a difference.
We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension schemes, insurance coverage, and wellness benefits, as well as excellent opportunities for continued professional development throughout your career.
Would you like to bring your dog to work? No problem. We have spacious facilities specifically designated for employees' dogs.
Would You Like to Join Our Team?
If you are an experienced veterinarian who values variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to work across a broad range of disciplines, we would love to hear from you!
If you have questions about the position or your development opportunities with us, please contact:
Jens Berisson, Hospital Director jens.berisson@anicura.se
Emma Idman, Talent Acquisition Partner emma.idman@anicura.se
Welcome to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital – where you can make full use of your veterinary expertise.

Are you passionate about the intersection of Python programming, electronics, and radio frequency technology? On behalf of our client – an innovative and publicly listed telecom pioneer in Kista – Academic Work is looking for an RF Test Engineer. In this role, you will play a key part in the core R&D organization, developing automated test sequences for next-generation digital coverage solutions and 5G infrastructure. Apply today, as we apply ongoing selection!
About the role
Our client develops patented, digital coverage solutions (Distributed Antenna Systems) engineered for demanding environments such as rail and road tunnels, subways, arenas, and large commercial venues. Their systems support commercial cellular networks from 2G up to 5G, as well as mission-critical public safety networks. In this position, you will join a specialized hardware development team of around six engineers at the global headquarters in Kista. The role is focused on the intersection of software and electronics: your primary mission is to build, maintain, and optimize automated RF test sequences and scripts in Python to verify products at both module and system level before they transition into series production. Because the position requires hands-on verification with instruments and test rigs in the laboratory, work is primarily conducted on-site in Kista, with the possibility of working remotely one day per week.
You will act as an essential link between internal R&D and manufacturing. Internally, you will collaborate daily with hardware, mechanics, and radio engineers, as well as a larger software development team. You will have no direct customer-facing duties; instead, your primary external stakeholders are production partners and manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Estonia. The role includes occasional travel—approximately 3 to 4 weeks per year—to install, configure, and troubleshoot test setups on-site at the manufacturing plants. You will become part of an open, supportive engineering culture characterized by flat hierarchies, shared daily fika breaks, and a transparent mindset where catching mistakes early and solving complex challenges together is valued above all else.
You are offered:
A technically versatile role working with cutting-edge 5G and cellular hardware solutions.
A tight-knit, collaborative team culture with short decision paths and high engineering expertise.
Occupational pension aligned with ITP1, wellness allowance, and free access to the building’s gym facilities.

Work tasks
Develop automated RF test sequences using Python, perform hardware lab verifications, and coordinate with production sites to ensure product quality.
Develop, maintain, and execute automated RF test sequences and scripts using Python.  
Perform test and verification at module and system levels on proprietary hardware and electronics.  
Set up and operate automated test equipment (ATE) and RF lab instruments, including spectrum analyzers and signal generators.  
Build, commission, and optimize automated test rigs for both laboratory development and factory production.  
Conduct lab-based hardware troubleshooting and analysis down to board and component levels.  
Collaborate closely with software and radio engineers to expand test coverage and streamline test cycles.  
Support external manufacturing partners and travel to production sites (approx. 3–4 weeks/year) to deploy and verify test setups.  
Document test methods, procedures, and test results within Jira and Confluence.

We are looking for
An academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communication, Applied Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
At least 1 year of documented professional experience in Python programming for automation, scripting, or hardware test control - either from your education or previous work experience.
Practical hands-on experience working with RF test instrumentation (e.g., spectrum analyzers, signal generators) or Automated Test Equipment (ATE).
Good technical understanding of cellular standards such as LTE (4G) and 5G NR.
Comfort working in Linux environments and performing hands-on lab work.
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is used in technical documentation and manufacturing communication.
This position requires that you hold a valid work permit or have the legal right to work in Sweden.

It is meritorious if you have
Experience reading electronic schematics and circuit diagrams.
Knowledge of database management and SQL.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and project tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Practical experience with hardware prototyping platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi).

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Intellectually curious
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: Small Animal Veterinarian with focus on Reproduction
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.

Solid foundational understanding of control engineering, mechatronic systems, or thermodynamic processes.
Practical experience in software development—either through model-based development (Matlab/Simulink) or text-based embedded programming (C/C++).
Working familiarity with software testing or simulation concepts (e.g., MIL, SIL, or HIL).
Languages: Working proficiency / business fluency in English (written and spoken).

Several years of dedicated industry experience in embedded software or controls engineering.
Knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration cycles, or hydraulic systems.

Familiarity with agile development practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and modern CI/CD tooling (e.g., Git, Jira, Jenkins).

Summary: The Pharmacovigilance Specialist for the Nordics is responsible for: in collaboration with the Pharmacovigilance Manager, to maintain an efficient local Pharmacovigilance system in the Nordic countries meeting the European and national regulations and in compliance with the Baxter Pharmacovigilance procedures. To ensure appropriate contacts with the other organizations not limited to country Regulatory Affairs, Country Quality Assurance, Business Units and with HCP and Competent authorities (MPA, FIMEA, DMA, NOMA, IMA). To work closely with the PV team based in UK according to the cluster model.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, or a related healthcare/pharmaceutical role.
Fluent in Danish, Swedish, and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a regulated environment.
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.

Full list of responsibilities
The PV Specialist is accountable and responsible for the following activities:

1. ADR Reporting:
·To collect, document, follow-up all local AEs and other pharmacovigilance information (e.g. pregnancy, medication error, lack of efficacy) from all sources according to SOPs
·To transmit all reports to GPS (Global Patient Safety) in a timely manner
·To make all efforts to answer the queries of the GPS organization and to use the specific follow-up questionnaires
·To answer the safety questions from the Health Care Professionals with the support of the cluster PV Manager, PV Director and the GPS organization, and Medical affairs if necessary
·To close and archive ADR reports according to SOPs

2. Clinical trials activities:
·If stated in the protocol, to process the SAEs and transmit them to the GPS according to SOPs.
3. Audits and inspections
·To act as local PV representative during inspections and audits, actively participating to the inspection/audit during interview sessions and providing document requests
·In coordination with the cluster PV Manager, EU-QPPV office and GPS, to investigate and provide/ support responses to inspection and audit findings, and implement Corrective and
Preventive actions
4. Agreements with third parties
·To collaborate with agreement owners, country QA and with the EMEA PV agreements team to ensure that any relevant Agreement with Third Party include appropriate PV clause or full SDEA
·To support the EMEA PV Agreement team in the implementation of local PSPs/MRPs, in collaboration with the initiator
·To notify safety signals to third party (distributor or PV supplier) in country/cluster as per procedure
·To perform reconciliation of Adverse Events with third party/PV Service Supplier
5. Other local PV activities
·To be involved in the communication on PV topics with national Competent Authorities, and supports answers preparation in cooperation with cluster PV Manager, GPS and Eu QPPV
·To perform surveillance activities for any new potential safety information (e.g. similar AEs reported in a cluster of reports or multiple cases for one batch received in a short time frame) and escalate as per procedures
·To alert the cluster PV Manager about any safety related issues without delay
·To prepare highlights as needed and represent PV at Nordic Quality Review Meeting (QMR)
·To be aware of required local risk minimization activities
·To perform local literature review, including assessment of local journals for screening, as described in SOP
·According to the process established at EU level, to validate the comparative table prepared by RA to put CCDS/CCSI/RSI and the local SPC in conformity
6. Regulatory intelligence
·Local regulatory intelligence: To regularly screen the websites of Competent Authorities in The Nordic countries for safety signals, Pharmacovigilance newsletters, regulations, etc
·To inform Pharmacovigilance Manager, EU QPPV and GPS on relevant changes concerning National regulations
7. Training:
·To perform trainings as required and keep up to date personal training records.
·To provide appropriate training on PV to new employees, partners and vendors
·To keep up to date records of the internal Pharmacovigilance trainings made to Baxter employees, partners or vendors
·To assist in onboarding and training of new team members
8. Procedures:
·To create, issue, implement and update local Pharmacovigilance related procedures as needed, in collaboration with the cluster PV team and Manager.
·To implement global Pharmacovigilance SOPs.
9. Compliance:
·To closely monitor local compliance and ensure all efforts are made to achieve high compliance rates.
·To open process errors according to SOPs and help in the resolution of noncompliance Reports
10. Activities related to associated countries in the Cluster:
·To collaborate closely with the UK Team members on above activities and provide any relevant information or support according to the cluster model

jobs.occupation: Business Director - K.D. Feddersen Recycling Solutions
jobs.description:
Why Join K.D. Feddersen Recycling Solutions?
K.D. Feddersen Recycling Solutions is looking for a Business Director who wants to lead, develop and shape a business area experiencing strong market demand. The company is part of the Feddersen Group, with operations worldwide and a particularly strong presence across Europe and the Baltic region.
We are looking for an ambitious and business-driven leader ready to take ownership of a Nordic business area and play a key role in shaping its future. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys combining leadership, sales and strategic responsibility while creating lasting business impact.
Your Future Workplace
This is a rare opportunity to lead a Nordic business area with full commercial responsibility, combining sales leadership, strategic influence and operational execution. Reporting directly to the Nordic Board, you will shape the area's direction, drive profitability and strengthen the company's market position across the Nordics.
As Business Director – Recycling, you will hold full budget and P&L responsibility for the business area. You will lead and support employees across the Nordic region while remaining actively involved in customer relationships, key account management and business development.
The business area focuses on project sales, agency representation, tender processes, service operations and recycling solutions for industrial customers. With significant autonomy, influence and responsibility, you will play a key role in the continued growth and success of the Nordic organization.
Your New Challenge
In this role, you will have broad responsibility spanning leadership, sales and business performance. You will work both strategically and operationally with considerable freedom and close interaction with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities

Drive sales performance and profitability with full budget and P&L responsibility.

Develop and execute the business area's strategy and objectives.

Lead customer meetings, negotiations and commercial activities across the Nordics.

Strengthen strategic customer accounts and build strong partnerships with suppliers and industry stakeholders.

Lead, coach and expand the Nordic team.

Prepare and negotiate commercial agreements, quotations and pricing proposals.

Drive continuous improvements in processes, systems and ways of working.

Participate in management team activities and report directly to the Nordic Board.

What Makes This Role Unique?

Real authority to shape and influence a SEK 100 million Nordic business.

High level of autonomy with direct impact on strategic and commercial decisions.

Opportunity to build, develop and expand your own team.

International exposure through collaboration with suppliers and stakeholders across multiple markets.

A highly visible role with significant influence on future performance and market presence.

Entrepreneurial culture with short decision-making paths and strong team spirit.

About You
We are looking for a commercially driven, ambitious and down-to-earth leader who enjoys combining sales, leadership and business responsibility. You have a strong business mindset, the ability to identify opportunities and the determination to turn plans into results.
Through professionalism, structure and energy, you create engagement internally while delivering sustainable business performance. You are equally comfortable discussing long-term direction with the board as you are leading commercial activities in the market.
Qualifications

Experience in B2B sales, preferably within project sales, technical sales or industrial sales.

Experience leading teams, projects or commercial initiatives.

Proven experience with budget and P&L responsibility.

Strong negotiation skills and confidence in customer-facing situations.

Fluent in both Swedish and English.

Preferred Experience

Experience working with international suppliers.

Knowledge of the plastics, recycling or process industries.

Proficiency in one or more Nordic languages.

Personal Attributes
You are someone who:

Takes initiative, drives results and thrives in a dynamic environment.

Navigates complex sales processes and drives opportunities from initial dialogue to signed agreement.

Is humble, approachable and enjoys staying close to both customers and colleagues.

Has the patience and persistence required for project-based sales cycles.

Has a genuine interest in industrial solutions, plastics, recycling, sustainability and process technologies.

At K.D. Feddersen Recycling Solutions, you will work in a close-knit team with short decision-making paths while benefiting from the resources and stability of a larger international organization.
The company is foundation-owned, creating a long-term perspective with stable ownership and sustainable investments in both the business and its people.
We're Here to Support You
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline.
If you're motivated by leadership, commercial responsibility and the opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing international business, we'd like to hear from you.
We look forward to learning more about your background, ambitions and how you can contribute to the continued success of K.D. Feddersen Recycling Solutions.

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Finance Lead to join a fast-scaling AI company backed by NVIDIA, Microsoft, and AWS, and to grow with it.
About Antrino
Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent.
The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, machines idle, space goes unused, and decisions about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, real-time information it can act on.
We have grown from 6 people to a team of 28 in less than a year, closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and are registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP). Everything we build follows Privacy by Design.
The role
This is not a traditional accounting position. Half the job is making the financial foundation work exceptionally well: payroll, bookkeeping, tax, payments, reporting, and administration, together with our founders and external advisers. The other half is commercial: working with the founders on pricing, business models, cost structures, and where the company puts its money.
One day you might be running payroll and closing the month. The next, you could be modeling the economics of deploying our platform across hundreds of customer sites, finding a European innovation grant, or helping the CEO evaluate a new commercial opportunity.
What you will work on
• Bookkeeping, reconciliations, and monthly and annual closing in Fortnox.
• Payroll, benefits, reimbursements, VAT, and tax, together with our auditors and banks.
• Invoicing, supplier payments, accounts payable and receivable, and corporate cards (Mynt).
• Filings with Bolagsverket and Skatteverket, board materials, minutes, and shareholder documentation.
• Budgets, forecasts, cash flow and runway models, and reporting for leadership, the board, and investors.
• Unit economics across cloud, AI inference, hardware, and deployment, and the margins they produce.
• Grants and non-dilutive funding from Swedish and European programmes.
• Replacing repetitive finance work with AI and modern software, so the function scales without its overhead growing at the same rate.
Who we are looking for
You are early in your career, with a strong financial foundation and an appetite for far more responsibility than you have today. You might be at a Big Four or mid-sized audit firm, an accounting agency, or in finance operations at a growing company.
• Around 2–4 years in accounting, auditing, or financial operations.
• Solid command of Swedish bookkeeping, payroll, and compliance, and hands-on experience with Fortnox or similar.
• Strong analytical skills and a real interest in modeling and commercial analysis.
• Excellent Swedish and English, written and spoken.
You take responsibility for the outcome, not just the task. You know payroll and tax have to be right every time while almost everything else moves fast, and you can hold both. You do not wait to be asked before fixing a process or chasing an opportunity.
It is a plus if you have worked with startups or venture-backed companies, understand SaaS metrics and unit economics, or have applied for funding through Vinnova, Almi, or EU programmes. You do not need all of this. We care more about judgment and how fast you learn than about years on your CV.
Life at Antrino
You will join a team of driven, ambitious people who thrive at a fast pace and enjoy working together. We go to AI events, host our own, and end plenty of weeks with an afterwork. Things change quickly here, and everyone's work is visible in what the company becomes.
What we offer
• Direct work with the CEO and board members on financial and commercial decisions.
• Exposure to fundraising, investor relations, and international expansion.
• Potential participation in our stock option programme after the probationary period.
• Freedom to improve systems, challenge processes, and bring AI into finance work.
• AI events, afterworks, team activities, and travel when the business requires it.
• Occupational pension, insurance, and friskvårdsbidrag.
Process
1. Introductory conversation about your background and ambitions.
2. Finance and accounting conversation about your hands-on experience.
3. Practical working session on a realistic scenario in operations, forecasting, or a commercial decision. We care how you think.
4. Conversation with the founders about options and terms.
We review applications continuously. References may be requested at the final stage.
Apply with your CV and a short note on why you want to move beyond traditional accounting into helping build a technology company.

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

A Senior Vision Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, reverse-engineering, and maintaining machine vision and optical inspection systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving cameras, lighting configurations, and image processing algorithms, supporting both legacy production line re-commissioning and new vision system installations. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with PLCs, SCADA, and upper-level MES platforms to enable inline defect traceability, dimensional inspection, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production. 

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 

Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  

Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  

Lead vision system integration and optical calibration during equipment commissioning and line re-starts (Project timeline dependent). 

Develop and reverse-engineer the vision inspection systems to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory, as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 

Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  

Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on machine vision, optics, and quality inspection gates. 

Code review and test of suppliers' vision software and algorithmic work within the projects to validate specified defect detection thresholds (Gauge R&R) and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper-level systems. 

Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 

Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 

Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 

The role requires regular presence on the production floor, with a minimum of approximately 25% of working hours spent on-site. Depending on project needs (such as line re-commissioning), there may be periods where up to 100% of working hours are required on the shop floor. 
Develop and maintain machine vision and image processing programming standards. 

Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 

Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 

Masters Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 

Minimum of 7 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 

Experience of working with industrial camera systems, optical components, and lighting techniques, including the selection, configuration, and calibration of camera hardware for manufacturing inspection and process control applications 

Experience in the design, configuration, and deployment of machine vision systems including cameras, lighting, and vision software platforms such as Cognex, Halcon, or equivalent, with experience integrating vision outputs into PLC, SCADA, and MES environments via OPC connectivity. 

Experience developing and optimising image processing pipelines and vision algorithms for applications such as defect detection, pattern recognition, and dimensional verification, with familiarity with industrial communication protocols for vision system integration. 

Experience in writing technical documentation including inspection requirement specifications, algorithm validation reports, vision system configuration records, functional design, UML, test cases, and test records. 

Experience with image processing software and programming tools relevant to industrial vision applications, such as Python, C++, OpenCV, or equivalent vision libraries, with the ability to develop, test, and optimise vision algorithms for real-time manufacturing environments 

Experienced continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 

Specific skills 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 

Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 

Highly autonomous with a proactive mindset and work ethic.  

Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 

Ability to document technical problems concisely. 

Experience in coaching, upskilling, and mentoring engineers or technicians, with a demonstrable commitment to developing the technical capability of others within a production environment. 

Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 

Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 

Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 

A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

As part of building our Maintenance Engineering organization, we are expanding our team with a Process Equipment Engineer focused on our Furnace Area. This is an opportunity to contribute to a technically advanced manufacturing environment and play an important part in strengthening our capabilities within the Furnace Area.
Read more about Silex here.
The team and the area
You will be part of the Maintenance Engineering organization and report to the Maintenance Manager. The Teams purpose is to provide technical leadership for assigned equipment and work closely with Team Managers, Service Technicians, Maintenance Engineers, Process Engineers, Area Managers, and external suppliers.
The Furnace Area is an important part of our production and includes advanced high-temperature processes such as epitaxy, Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD), and thermal oxidation. These processes are used to grow and deposit controlled material layers and to form high-quality oxide films, making stable temperature profiles, gas flows, pressure, and equipment conditions essential to product quality and process repeatability. You will bridge equipment maintenance and process engineering, using equipment data, process results, and production feedback to identify causes of instability, improve uptime and utilization, and ensure that technical actions are coordinated across teams.
About the role
As a Process Equipment Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical health, reliability, and continuous improvement of equipment within the Furnace Area. Equipment is your primary discipline, supported by process knowledge that enables effective fault analysis, improvement work, and close collaboration with Process Engineers.
You will act as the technical lead for the assigned equipment, guide service technicians, coordinate technical escalations, and lead root cause analyses of downtime events and recurring failures. You will also develop equipment monitoring and preventive maintenance, define relevant KPIs, contribute to equipment purchases and upgrades, and serve as a technical contact for suppliers.
In this role, you will:

Act as the technical lead for assigned furnace equipment, guiding service technicians and leading complex troubleshooting, root cause analyses, and follow-up of corrective actions.

Manage technical escalation plans and coordinate equipment status, priorities, and actions with Team Managers, Process Engineers, and suppliers.

Use equipment and process data to identify causes of instability, define and follow up KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, and MTTR, and improve equipment monitoring through equipment dashboard and SPC.

Develop preventive maintenance routines, maintain technical documentation, and contribute to equipment purchases, installations, upgrades, and spare-part planning.

Lead equipment-related risk analyses and ensure LOTO and other safety requirements are reflected in maintenance routines, documentation, and training.

We are looking for someone who has:

A Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

At least five years of relevant experience in manufacturing with strong equipment-related knowledge and an understanding of production processes. Experience in semiconductor or MEMS process development or manufacturing is an advantage.

Experience with root cause analysis, data analysis, SPC, quality-control methods, equipment monitoring, and preventive maintenance systems.

Proficiency in English, particularly in technical terminology and documentation. Swedish is considered as highly meritorious.

To thrive in this role, you enjoy working analytically and finding practical solutions to complex technical challenges. You take a structured and proactive approach to your work, communicate clearly with different stakeholders, and are comfortable guiding others. With several activities often running in parallel, you are also able to prioritize effectively and ensure that actions are documented and followed through.
What we offer you

The opportunity to work with cutting-edge MEMS technology and some of the most advanced equipment in the industry.

A technically challenging environment where you solve complex problems and continuously develop your expertise.

A varied role in which new challenges, technologies, and improvement opportunities make every day different.

About Silex
Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.
The recruitment process
We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.
